profile.bio: ML Intern | Computer Science Student | Researcher | Tech Enthusiast
profile.about: I am a student at **Gayatri Vidya Parishad College of Engineering (Autonomous)** in **Computer Science** with a CGPA of **8.65/10.0**. Currently a **ML Intern** at **NITT**, focusing on machine learning and data science applications. Also experienced as an **AI ML Intern** at **Eduskills**, working with **AWS SageMaker** and cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Developing MAPPO-based Reinforcement Learning policies for deadlock-aware navigation and obstacle interaction in Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) environments. Implementing uncertainty-aware action evaluation and simulation-driven policy learning for adaptive path planning in dynamic maps. Benchmarking multi-agent RL performance and optimizing policy training pipelines for improved simulation stability and execution efficiency.

positions.title: AI ML Intern
positions.description: Created AWS buckets and instances like EC2. Built models and worked with AWS tools like AWS SageMaker. Gained experience covering the entire machine learning lifecycle, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment within a cloud environment.

projects.title: NAMO Deadlock Detection & RL Navigation Assistance
projects.description: Developing MAPPO-based Reinforcement Learning policies for deadlock-aware navigation and obstacle interaction in NAMO environments. Implements uncertainty-aware action evaluation and simulation-driven policy training.

projects.title: Spam Classification & Vectorization Analysis
projects.description: Built a spam classification pipeline using merged SMS/email datasets (~100k samples). Evaluated TF-IDF vectorization with Random Forest, XGBoost, SGDClassifier, and Logistic Regression; achieved ~94.3% accuracy and 0.93 F1-score.

projects.title: Stroke Prediction using Classical ML Models
projects.description: Comparative analysis of supervised ML algorithms for stroke prediction on imbalanced healthcare datasets. Used GridSearchCV, SMOTE balancing, and 5-fold CV; achieved 94.69% test accuracy with XGBoost.

projects.title: Property Hub
projects.description: Architected a full-stack classifieds platform with advanced search, responsive frontend, custom admin dashboard, secure RESTful APIs, and view-count analytics.

education.institution: Gayatri Vidya Parishad College of Engineering (Autonomous)
education.details: Coursework includes Data Structures, Algorithms, Databases, Computer Systems, and Machine Learning. Published two research papers with TechRXiv and IJSDR.

publications.title: Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Text Vectorization Techniques for Spam Detection
publications.description: This paper presents a comparative analysis of machine learning algorithms — including Naive Bayes, SVM, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest — combined with text vectorization techniques such as TF-IDF and Count Vectorizer. The study evaluates their effectiveness in detecting spam messages across benchmark datasets, identifying optimal model-vectorizer pairings.

publications.title: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
publications.description: An in-depth comparison of supervised machine learning algorithms — including Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN, and Logistic Regression — applied to breast cancer classification using the Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC) dataset. The paper benchmarks accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score to identify the most reliable model for clinical decision support.
